701190101.text: Hmm... I have to finish this before the Prime Ice melts. But... *sigh* What placement works best here?

701190102.text: What do you think...? And you as well... Ah, if only the three of you could actually talk to me, my work would go much more smoothly.

701190103.text: Hey, there's a weird guy over here!

701190104.text: *sigh* Yes, I know. A man all alone in the wild, mumbling to three animal ice sculptures... Anyone who saw that would freak out and call me weird.

701190105.text: *sigh* Dragov, Dragov... You have to think of something, quickly...

701190106.text: Huh? Are you waiting for someone named Dragov? Is he going to help you?

701190107.text: Yes, but unfortunately, Dragov is me. I'm waiting for myself to help myself, but I can't seem to lend myself a hand.

701190108.text: It's like trying to pull yourself up by your own collar... Do you understand?

701190110.text: Oh, right! Then you could pull yourself up with a rope!

701190111.text: Wonderful. We've solved the problem of not being able to pull oneself up... Now I just hope that helps with my actual troubles!

701190115.text: So, Dragov... what are you trying to do out here?

701190116.text: I'm... *sigh* I'm a photographer for "Pioneers." I'm trying to take some shots for an art exhibition of Prime Ice sculptures.

701190117.text: I need to find a way to make these three Prime Ice animal sculptures look good on camera.

701190118.text: But first... Prime Ice sculptures are very heavy. I already used up all my strength just to get them here. And second... I do have a vague idea, and I've already picked out the spot for the shot.

701190119.text: But if I put all three sculptures in place only to realize I was wrong, I'll regret it for the rest of the day...

701190120.text: So basically, you want to put the Prime Ice sculptures in those three spots. That should be easy enough for us to handle.

701190121.text: Huh, really? How would you... Oh, right. Now that I look closely, this lady here is floating in midair herself. Perhaps she could make Prime Ice sculptures float, too...

701190122.text: Paimon can't do that! Well... that's not important. Why don't you tell us what you have in mind first?

701190124.text: This is a <color=#00E1FFFF>Nochhornowl</color>. A large bird like this should be paired with a <color=#00E1FFFF>towering tree</color>...

701190125.text: A <color=#00E1FFFF>Fluffahog</color> ought to drift into sleep in a place wreathed in <color=#00E1FFFF>warm mist</color>...

701190126.text: And as for the <color=#00E1FFFF>Morozhound</color>, it treads across frozen ground and snowy plains. A backdrop of <color=#00E1FFFF>snowy mountains</color> should suit it nicely...

701190127.text: That's what I have in mind for now.

701190128.text: All right, then let's try putting them up the way you wanted!

701190113.text: #This {M#gentleman}{F#lady} looks so noble and elegant, yet the moment {M#he}{F#she} opens {M#his}{F#her} mouth, it's to suggest grabbing someone by the collar.

701190114.text: #What {NICKNAME} means is, if you can't solve it on your own, you can try asking someone else for help... Like us!

701190201.text: Hmm... I hope we can get the photos taken soon. Prime Ice doesn't keep well...

701190202.text: What’s wrong? Is there something about moving the Prime Ice sculptures that you're unsure of?

701190204.text: Hmm... A <color=#00E1FFFF>Nochhornowl</color>. A large bird like this should be paired with a <color=#00E1FFFF>towering tree</color>...

701190205.text: Speaking of towering trees, the largest tree in Snezhnaya would be the Tsar's White Birch of the Pale Crown Palace...

701190207.text: Hmm... A <color=#00E1FFFF>Fluffahog</color> ought to drift into sleep in a place wreathed in <color=#00E1FFFF>warm mist</color>...

701190208.text: Of course, there’s no warm mist out on the tundra.

701190209.text: Still, if we use clouds, fog, or something similar to create the impression of heat, that should be enough. Atmosphere is what matters most in a photo, after all...

701190211.text: And as for the <color=#00E1FFFF>Morozhound</color>, it treads across frozen ground and snowy plains. A backdrop of <color=#00E1FFFF>snowy mountains</color> should suit it nicely...

701190212.text: The shape of a snowy mountain would complement the Morozhound sculpture well...

701190301.text: Ah... Now I should be able to get the photos in time... Otherwise, I won't be getting paid for this job.

701190302.text: And if I can't finish the shoot, I won't even get the reimbursement for the sculptures. I'd have to pay for them out of my own pocket...
